verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The one display is two fields of the Lean structure: `decomposition` gives u w = spatialCurl A w + D w for every w with w.1 < 1, and `direct_angular` gives D = angularField b on the preterminal set; substituting the second into the first yields u = curl 𝒜 + ℬ e_θ, which is the display (and (3.3)). `angularField b w` is b(cylPoint w) · (−y/r, x/r, 0), i.e. a scalar multiple of e_θ, and its coefficient type `Coefficient = ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ` takes only (t, r, z), so the paper's "ℬ is independent of θ" is built into the encoding rather than asserted. p^loc is only a name in the display; it is the structure's field p, with no formula to compare. Both fields hold on the same set: `decomposition` on {w | w.1 < 1} and `direct_angular` on `PhysicalWaveSum.preterminal`, which is defined as `{w | w.1 < 1}` (PhysicalWaveSum.lean:386), so the substitution needs no intersection; that set contains the paper's Ω_*.
